title: "Daphnia food calculator"
format: html
engine: knitr
filters:

---

## Purpose

*Daphnia magna* culture jars for the "Low-quality" treatment (Table 1 in [Experimental Design](../5_experimental_design.qmd)) are fed a 50:50 mix (by carbon) of *Tetradesmus obliquus* and *Synechococcus elongatus*, dosed to a target carbon concentration per jar (see [Parameters](../3_parameters.qmd) and [Calculations](../4_calculations.qmd)). Because the carbon content of each medium changes from batch to batch, the volume to add has to be recalculated from a fresh optical density (OD) reading before every feeding, using an OD-to-carbon calibration curve fitted per species. This app takes today's OD readings and the number of *Daphnia* culture jars to feed, and returns how much of each medium to add.

The app below runs entirely in the browser (via [Shinylive](https://shiny.posit.co/py/docs/shinylive.html)) — no R server needed, so it works straight from the rendered page. After editing the code in this file, re-render it so the embedded app picks up the change:

```sh
quarto render calculations/food_calculator.qmd
```

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 480

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  numericInput(
    "n_cultures",
    "Number of Daphnia culture jars",
    value = 35,
    min = 1
  ),
  numericInput(
    "od_tetra",
    "Optical density of Tetradesmus obliquus",
    value = 0.65,
    step = 0.01
  ),
  numericInput(
    "od_syn",
    "Optical density of Synechococcus elongatus",
    value = 0.67,
    step = 0.01
  ),
  tableOutput("result")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$result <- renderTable({

    ## Fixed parameters
    # Shinylive apps run entirely client-side in the browser (webR), with no access
    # to repository files at runtime, so these mirror the values in 3_parameters.qmd
    # rather than being read from it. Update both places together if they change.
    culture_volume_mL <- 800    # medium volume per Daphnia jar
    target_C_mg_per_L <- 2      # carbon target per jar, matches Daphnia_fed_C_mg_per_litre_per_day in 3_parameters.qmd
    extra <- 0.25                # buffer added to the total volume to cover pipetting loss

    frac_tetra <- 0.5           # share of carbon from Tetradesmus, matches Phytoplankton_low_quality_food_ratio in 3_parameters.qmd
    slope_tetra <- 158.32
    intercept_tetra <- -10.991

    frac_syn <- 0.5
    slope_syn <- 89.419
    intercept_syn <- -4.463

    ## Tetradesmus obliquus
    tetra_per_jar_mL <-
      ((culture_volume_mL * target_C_mg_per_L) /
         ((slope_tetra * input$od_tetra) - intercept_tetra)) *
      frac_tetra

    tetra_total_mL <- tetra_per_jar_mL * input$n_cultures
    tetra_total_extra_mL <- tetra_total_mL * (1 + extra)

    ## Synechococcus elongatus
    syn_per_jar_mL <-
      ((culture_volume_mL * target_C_mg_per_L) /
         ((slope_syn * input$od_syn) - intercept_syn)) *
      frac_syn

    syn_total_mL <- syn_per_jar_mL * input$n_cultures
    syn_total_extra_mL <- syn_total_mL * (1 + extra)

    data.frame(
      Quantity = c(
        "Tetradesmus per jar (mL)",
        "Tetradesmus total (mL)",
        "Tetradesmus total +25% (mL)",
        "Synechococcus per jar (mL)",
        "Synechococcus total (mL)",
        "Synechococcus total +25% (mL)",
        "Total mix +25% (mL)"
      ),
      Value = round(c(
        tetra_per_jar_mL,
        tetra_total_mL,
        tetra_total_extra_mL,
        syn_per_jar_mL,
        syn_total_mL,
        syn_total_extra_mL,
        tetra_total_extra_mL + syn_total_extra_mL
      ), 1)
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
